limits: Same-user process/profile/workspace separation, not OS containment; shared host visibility remains.
Capture is a verified bounded snapshot, not atomic. Explicit credential/special-file/dependency omissions are retained.
External scientific artifacts require explicit path/provenance declarations; native profile skills are captured automatically without auth/history.
Conditional replay uses the complete stopped copy and existing environment/cache bytes. It performs no automatic repair/retrieval and declines unsupported external pointers or container relocation.
Replay observation-only skill links/errors do not restrict scientific execution evidence unless referenced by the workspace.
Outer Duct captures local session processes; detached or remote work may be unmeasured.
